register_param_parametrization: register a parametrization on a module tensor to transform weight values during forward pass
remove_param_parametrizations: remove parametrizations from a module tensor while preserving or restoring the original tensor
test_is_parametrized: test if a module or specific tensor attribute has a parametrization registered
run_cached_context: run a forward pass with cached parametrized tensor computations to avoid redundant evaluations
transfer_param_parametrizations: transfer parametrizations and their parameters from one module to another module
